title: Which loop did the network use?
instruction: For each part of a social network, choose the loop that runs in it.

items.text: Show 10 new posts from friends and then “You’re all caught up”
items.why: The number is known in advance, and the feed has an end.

items.text: Keep playing videos until the user closes the app
items.why: The end depends only on you.

items.text: The loading wheel spins until the data arrives
items.why: It ends when something happens: the data arrives.

items.text: A story with three photos in a row
Keep playing videos until the 30-minute time limit is up
items.why: A stopping condition you set yourself.

items.text: The logo in the corner keeps slowly pulsing
items.why: A decoration that runs the whole time and has no point at which to end.

debrief: A fixed count has its end known in advance; “until” ends on a condition. A feed with no end is a loop whose only stopping condition is you.
